versions.changelog:
Initial release of solcal-recovery: the OpenClaw repair toolkit.

- Automated diagnostics for configs, skills, APIs, connectivity, and disk.
- One-click backup, restore, and emergency reset functions.
- AI-assisted repair using supported local LLMs.
- Safe "Quick Start" launch with pre-flight checks.
- Beginner-friendly: designed to help get OpenClaw agents back online fast.
